BiblicalUsage: Bathah means desolation, a waste place, and Isaiah says the vineyard that bears wild grapes will be laid waste, neither pruned nor dug, and briers and thorns will come up in it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a laid-waste vineyard is the end of unfruitfulness, because God gives His vineyard every care and then judges it by its fruit.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
